AutoBurst.Description: Enables Ley Lines. Continue pressing ST/AoE; scripted openers stay off. Ley Lines stays because the same button also supplies manual Retrace.

AutoMitigation.Description: Enables Manaward through ST for detected group damage. Wrath applies its readiness, content, HP and damage-detection conditions. Keep manual defenses for deliberate timing and paths not covered by automation. Automated and manual uses share cooldowns.

AutoMechanics.Description: Fire/ice and resource flow are already handled. Transpose stays for downtime.
